text:
Maya: Ok team — tight timeline. We need a compact GA acceptance checklist covering SLA, docs, support, monitoring, pricing by next Wednesday. Who owns which piece?
Devin: I can own SLA + infra validation. Quick Q: do we set target SLOs now or iterate after perf runs? @Sasha you'll need to validate.
Sasha: SRE will own monitoring/runbooks. Need clear SLO numbers to set alerts. Also require synthetic probes from each target region.
Rami: Docs owner here. Deliverables: quickstart, migration guide, API reference snippets, and a one-page "what's new" for customers.
Karen: Support readiness on me — playbook, oncall training, escalation matrix, customer-facing incident page. Need a day for routing + a couple training sessions.
Liam: Finance: I'll own pricing SKUs and quota enforcement. Need final SKU list to wire to billing by Friday.
Maya: Proposed GA acceptance criteria (short):
1) SLAs/SLOs defined and signed (owner: Devin)
2) Observability + synthetic tests in staging (owner: Sasha)
3) Docs published + migration examples (owner: Rami)
4) Support playbook + trained staff (owner: Karen)
5) Pricing SKUs + billing integration validated (owner: Liam)
6) Rollback/canary plan & runbook in place (owner: Devin/Sasha)
All must be green in staging by Monday 09:00 for GA.
Devin: For SLA suggestion:
- Standard tier: p99 latency <= 1s (8k context, small/med models), error rate < 0.5%
- Enterprise tier: p99 <= 600ms, error rate < 0.1%, dedicated capacity options
Also: availability SLO 99.9% monthly with credits policy. Thoughts?
Sasha: Those numbers look reasonable as targets. Monitoring acceptance checklist:
- dashboards: per-route latency (p50/p95/p99), error rate, token throughput
- synthetic probes: 1m cadence from each region
- alerts: token-error-rate > 0.5% (P1), p99 latency > threshold (P1), synthetic failure (P0)
- runbooks linked from alerts with clear play/rollback steps
If any synthetic test fails for >5m -> automated page.
Rami: Docs acceptance: live in /docs/ga/inference (internal + public). Requirements:
- Quickstart (5 min)
- Migration guide from beta endpoints
- SDK snippets (py, js) + code examples for streaming and function calls
- Changelog and compatibility notes
I'll have drafts by Tue EOD, PR link posted here.
Karen: Support acceptance:
- playbook in Confluence with triage matrix
- 2 support engineers trained + one SW engineer on-call for 48h rollover window
- escalation flow to SRE/Dev with SLAs internal: 15m ack for P0, 1h for P1
I'll schedule training Wed + Thu.
Liam: Pricing acceptance items:
- SKU catalog + per-unit definition (tokens, embedding units, request units)
- billing events exportable to CSV + sample invoice generation
- quota enforcement tested in staging with two pilot tenants
I can get SKU list by Fri morning.
Maya: Canary & rollback: we need a concrete rollout policy embedded in the runbook. Suggested: 5% for 48h, 25% for 24h, 100% after 72h if no regression. Also must include automatic fallback to previous model variant on error spikes.
Devin: Canary policy draft:
```
canary:
  stages:
    - percent: 5
      duration: 48h
    - percent: 25
      duration: 24h
    - percent: 100
      duration: 72h
  rollback_on: token-error-rate > 0.5% or p99 latency increase > 2x
```
Sasha: I'll hook canary monitors and ensure synthetic traffic exercises common prompts. Also will add a warming period for KV cache population.
Maya: Blockers? Anything preventing owners from hitting Monday 09:00 green?
Devin: GPU perf test for sustained 1M tokens/day per pool needs capacity reservation from infra. @infra-team — need 3x nodes reserved in staging.
Sasha: We'll re-run perf once infra confirms nodes — otherwise canary will be skewed.
Rami: No blockers for docs, but need final API tweaks by EOD Mon to avoid churn in examples.
Karen: Support needs the final incident templates + runbook link to complete training.
Liam: Need confirmation on whether we bill embeddings as separate unit or same token meter — decision affects SKU mapping.
Maya: Decision: if any of the six criteria are not green in staging by Monday 09:00, we defer GA by 1 week. Owners — please escalate early. I'll consolidate the checklist into a short tracker and post it tomorrow.
Devin: I'll follow up with a perf-task and canary policy PR.
Sasha: Adding monitoring dashboards + synthetic suite to staging today.
Rami: PR for docs by Tue EOD — will ping for review.
Karen: Training session invites sent for Wed/Thu.
Liam: SKU email to finance + billing by Fri 11:00.
Maya: Thanks — I'll send the tracker and owner checklist. Ping me if you need headcount or decisions. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: notify: Canary policy updated in staging per thread.
